nativeAdaptation.pty: portable-pty launches applications and clean interactive shells at the requested terminal geometry; a reader thread transports bytes while the owner thread feeds the terminal model.
nativeAdaptation.terminal: The Ghostty-derived qwertty-term-vt core preserves streaming UTF-8, combining characters, wide cells, dynamic palettes, full SGR attributes, and cursor geometry without a JavaScript or WASM runtime.
nativeAdaptation.renderer: Rust and fontdue render styled terminal snapshots directly to RGB PNG, including inverse, faint, bold, italic, invisible, underline variants, strike, overline, and cursor shapes.
nativeAdaptation.driver: A strict JSON scene format exposes application and shell launch, environment/path setup, wrappers, waits, keyboard probes, raw/key input, Unicode typing, indexed snapshots, and manifests through cargo xtask media capture.
